lore_anchors.definition: The ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty; a powerful Celestial Immortal and disciple of a mysterious Daofather. He commands 3,600 commanderies.
A high-ranking advisor to the Xia Emperor.
An elder of the Grand Xia’s royal clan, the maternal grandfather of the Yuchi clan’s Yuchi Xiyue.
The last surviving princess of the Yuchi clan, Ji Ning’s maternal cousin-sister (表姐). She has waited eighteen years for news of him.
A vast, ancient organization seeking to conquer the Three Realms. They possess an incredibly effective spy network.
A Seamless Gate special envoy; a Celestial Immortal-level operative.
A Celestial Immortal elder of the Shaoyin clan.
An ancient clan that has been in conflict with Ji Ning over the Yuchi clan’s legacy.

The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; it is featureless, devoid of Dao resonance, and forces cultivators to rely solely on physical arts and Heartforce for survival.
A localized, functional recreation of the original Six Paths of Reincarnation, established by Daofather Crimsonbright after the cosmic war shattered the original system.
The Celestial Immortal ancestor of the Shaoyin clan.
An Immortal of the Black-White College; colleague and friend of Ji Ning.
A premier immortal sect in Anchan City; Ji Ning’s home sect.
Ji Ning’s personal residence within the Black-White College.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Realm of Annihilation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the empty, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the Chaosverse; a death-trap for cultivators because it has no Dao resonance.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Xia Emperor suspicious of the 60+% of lords begging for help?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He suspects many have already defected to the Seamless Gate and are using the distress calls as cover to spy on or ambush his forces.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did the Seamless Gate know about Ji Ning being banished?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They have an extremely deep intelligence network, seemingly more effective than even the Xia Emperor’s Heavenly Treasures Mountain.
In Chinese family hierarchy, a maternal cousin (mother’s sister’s daughter or mother’s brother’s daughter) is a 表姐 (biao jie), distinct from a paternal cousin.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does Yan King hint at the end?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He has successfully tracked down the reincarnation information of Ji Ning’s parents, a mission Ji Ning entrusted to him years ago.
